verdict.rationale: Vercel's Fluid compute pricing documents Active CPU billing: you pay only for CPU time during actual code execution, not during I/O waits such as database or AI model calls. The same page says Provisioned Memory is billed for the whole instance lifetime in GB-hours, including during I/O, so part of the compute bill still tracks idle wall-clock time. Missing for 10: memory billing that excludes idle or I/O time, independent or hands-on corroboration of actual bills.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can pay only for active compute time rather than idle wall-clock time

citations.quote: You are only billed during actual code execution and not during I/O operations (database queries, like AI model calls, etc.)
Billed for the entire instance lifetime in GB-hours ... Continues billing while handling requests, even during I/O operations
Run server-side code on demand with Fluid compute, which scales concurrency for AI and I/O-heavy workloads.
